# Fueled By Chapters

> > A book-focused platform providing resources, reviews, and community engagement for readers and literary enthusiasts.

Fueled By Chapters is a literary community website that celebrates reading culture. The site integrates with Gravatar and Automattic services to enhance user experience and community interaction.

## Key Topics

- Book reviews and recommendations
- Reading community
- Literary discussions
- Privacy and data protection
- GDPR compliance
- User comments and engagement
- Contact forms
- Cookie policies
- Gravatar integration
- User rights and data collection
- Reader resources

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](https://fueledbychapters.com/privacy-policy): Privacy policy covering data collection, cookies, and GDPR compliance
